4. **Ernst Handel**: Umsatzsteigerung von CHF 26.06 auf CHF 951.33 (Steigerung um CHF 925.27)
5. **Queen Cozinha**: Umsatzsteigerung von CHF 4.78 auf CHF 890.78 (Steigerung um CHF 886.00)

Diese Kunden haben ihre Umsätze signifikant gesteigert über die betrachteten Zeiträume.
HX1.sql_query:
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id, 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month, 
        SUM(o.freight) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
),
CustomerOrderCount AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM public.orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 5
),
RevenueGrowth AS (
    SELECT 
        mr.customer_id,
        MIN(mr.month) AS first_month,
        MAX(mr.month) AS last_month,
        MIN(mr.monthly_revenue) AS first_month_revenue,
        MAX(mr.monthly_revenue) AS last_month_revenue,
        (MAX(mr.monthly_revenue) - MIN(mr.monthly_revenue)) AS revenue_growth
    FROM MonthlyRevenue mr
    JOIN CustomerOrderCount coc ON mr.customer_id = coc.customer_id
    GROUP BY mr.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.company_name, 
    rg.first_month, 
    rg.last_month, 
    rg.first_month_revenue, 
    rg.last_month_revenue, 
    rg.revenue_growth
FROM RevenueGrowth rg
JOIN public.customers c ON rg.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY rg.revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 5;

Die folgenden Regionen erzielen hohen Umsatz, obwohl ihre Auftragszahl unter dem Median liegt:

HX2.sql_query:
WITH RegionUmsatz AS (
    SELECT o.ship_region AS region, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS umsatz, COUNT(o.order_id) AS auftragszahl
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY o.ship_region
),
MedianAuftragszahl AS (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY auftragszahl) AS median_auftragszahl
    FROM RegionUmsatz
)
SELECT ru.region, ru.umsatz, ru.auftragszahl
FROM RegionUmsatz ru
JOIN MedianAuftragszahl ma ON ru.auftragszahl < ma.median_auftragszahl
ORDER BY ru.umsatz DESC;

Diese Paare zeigen eine stärkere Assoziation im Kaufverhalten als bei unabhängigen Käufen erwartet.
HX7.sql_query:
WITH ProductPairs AS (
    SELECT 
        od1.product_id AS product_id1, 
        od2.product_id AS product_id2, 
        COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM 
        public.order_details od1
    JOIN 
        public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
    JOIN 
        public.products p1 ON od1.product_id = p1.product_id
    JOIN 
        public.products p2 ON od2.product_id = p2.product_id
    WHERE 
        p1.category_id <> p2.category_id
    GROUP BY 
        od1.product_id, od2.product_id
),
ProductCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        public.order_details
    GROUP BY 
        product_id
),
LiftCalculation AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.product_id1, 
        pp.product_id2, 
        pp.pair_count, 
        pc1.total_count AS total_count1, 
        pc2.total_count AS total_count2,
        (pp.pair_count::float / (pc1.total_count * pc2.total_count)) AS lift
    FROM 
        ProductPairs pp
    JOIN 
        ProductCounts pc1 ON pp.product_id1 = pc1.product_id
    JOIN 
        ProductCounts pc2 ON pp.product_id2 = pc2.product_id
)
SELECT 
    p1.product_name AS product_name1, 
    p2.product_name AS product_name2, 
    lc.lift
FROM 
    LiftCalculation lc
JOIN 
    public.products p1 ON lc.product_id1 = p1.product_id
JOIN 
    public.products p2 ON lc.product_id2 = p2.product_id
ORDER BY 
    lc.lift DESC
LIMIT 10;

       SUM(od.quantity) AS total_sold,
